statements.name: create-user
statements.sql: INSERT INTO public.user_entity (id, username, email, first_name, last_name) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)

statements.name: lookup-by-username
statements.sql: SELECT id, username, email, first_name, last_name FROM public.user_entity WHERE username = $1

statements.name: lookup-by-email
statements.sql: SELECT id, username, email FROM public.user_entity WHERE email = $1

statements.name: update-profile
statements.sql: UPDATE public.user_entity SET email = $1, first_name = $2, last_name = $3 WHERE id = $4 RETURNING id, email

statements.name: reject-case-folded-email
statements.sql: SELECT id FROM public.user_entity WHERE lower(email) = $1

statements.name: reject-name-search
statements.sql: SELECT id FROM public.user_entity WHERE first_name = $1

statements.name: reject-protected-join
statements.sql: SELECT u.email FROM public.user_entity u JOIN public.realm r ON r.id = u.realm_id WHERE r.id = $1

statements.name: unprotected-realm-query
statements.sql: SELECT id, name FROM public.realm WHERE id = $1
